usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/sora-2/generate (x402, ~$0.40) with JSON body {prompt, seconds, size} -> {jobId}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIGN-IN-WITH-X (free, same wallet) until status=complete
usage.outputShape: POST -> body.jobId (+body.status:pending, body.type). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX) -> body.status (loading->complete), body.progress; on complete body.result.videoUrl + body.result.thumbnailUrl. Blob URLs expire ~20min, download immediately.
quirks: TWO-STEP ASYNC: POST only pays + returns {jobId, status:pending}; the actual video comes from polling, NOT the POST response.
POLL IS FREE via SIGN-IN-WITH-X (SIWX): GET /api/jobs/{jobId} signed by the SAME wallet that paid the POST. No per-poll charge (unlike the blockrun.ai sora-2 backend whose polls are paid).
Input shape is per-model: {prompt, seconds:'4'|'8'|'12', size:'1280x720'|'720x1280'}. seconds/size are STRINGS. Optional input_reference (blob URL) for image-to-video + autoCrop.
Price settled at exactly $0.40 (bottom of the sora-2 $0.40-$1.20 range, matches registry surface). Headline is a CAP; pass cap>=1.20 to be safe.
result.videoUrl is a Vercel Blob MP4 that expires ~20min after completion - download it immediately.
Pays USDC on Base (also Solana/Tempo), no API key.
usage.guide: StableStudio sora-2 text-to-video. POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/sora-2/generate with JSON {prompt, seconds, size} and pay-per-call x402 USDC on Base (~$0.40, cap range $0.40-$1.20). The POST only returns {jobId, status:pending} - it does not return the video. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIGN-IN-WITH-X signature (FREE, signed by the same wallet that paid) every ~30s until body.status=='complete' (~90s typical). Read body.result.videoUrl (and thumbnailUrl) and download immediately - the blob URLs expire in ~20min.
